subject: Welding and Fabrication
sourceFile: Technical & Trade -- WELDING AND FABRICATION ENGINEERING CRAFT PRACTICE.txt
examFormat: Three papers, all to be taken; Papers 1 and 2 form a composite paper taken at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice objective questions in 1 hour for 40 marks. Paper 2: five questions, any four answered in 1 1/2 hours for 60 marks. Paper 3: a practical test of 3 hours 10 minutes with one compulsory question for 100 marks (a list of materials is released at least two weeks earlier); if materials cannot be acquired, an alternative of one question in 3 hours for 100 marks may be used.
excluded: List of facilities and major equipment/materials, and recommended books.
